name: host-check
description: 通用主机体检（只读）：磁盘/内存水位断言、关键进程与监听端口核对，并留档负载/内存/时间同步。不改动任何东西，可随时对任意实例跑。

disk_max.description: 磁盘使用率阈值（百分比）
disk_max.hint: 超过该值即断言失败；例如 85

mem_max.description: 内存使用率阈值（百分比）
mem_max.hint: 超过该值即断言失败；例如 85

port.description: 要核对的监听端口（留空跳过）

mount.description: 要核对的挂载点（绝对路径）

steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
USE=$(df -P "${mount}" | awk 'NR==2{gsub(/%/,"",$5); print $5}')
echo "disk-use=${mount}=$USE%"
[ "$USE" -le ${disk_max} ] || { echo "disk-high ${mount}=$USE%（阈值 ${disk_max}%）" >&2; exit 3; }
echo disk-ok

set -euo pipefail
MEM=$(free -m | awk '/^Mem:/{printf "%d", $3*100/$2}')
echo "mem-use=$MEM%"
[ "$MEM" -le ${mem_max} ] || { echo "mem-high $MEM%（阈值 ${mem_max}%）" >&2; exit 4; }
echo mem-ok

set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${process_name}" ]; then
  echo 'process-skip（未提供 process_name）'
else
  pgrep -f "${process_name}" >/dev/null || { echo "process-missing ${process_name}" >&2; exit 5; }
  echo "process-ok ${process_name}"
fi
echo host-check-process-done

set -euo pipefail
if [ -z "${port}" ]; then
  echo 'port-skip（未提供 port）'
else
  ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | grep -qE "[:.]${port}$" || { echo "port-not-listening ${port}" >&2; exit 6; }
  echo "port-ok ${port}"
fi
echo host-check-port-done

steps.description: 留档：负载/内存/磁盘/时间同步/CPU
steps.script:
set -u
echo '== uptime =='; uptime
echo '== memory =='; free -m | head -n 2
echo '== disk =='; df -h | head -n 6
echo '== cpu =='; nproc
echo '== time =='; date
timedatectl 2>/dev/null | head -n 4 || echo 'timedatectl 不可用'
